def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    div=None

    above = max(i for i,_ in cells) < div

        dist = div-1 - max(i for i,_ in cells)
        g2=[row[:] for row in g]
        for i,j in cells: g2[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in cells: g2[i+dist][j]=cells_color
